text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Oh. My. GOSH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surprised to hear a familiar voice, I go to investigate what seems to be another problem…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: These are all amazing! You both took such great pictures! Really, wow!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, you're gonna make me blush, exaggeratin' like that! But anyway, glad ya like 'em!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Part of the reason they came out cute is because you're so cute!
choice_data_list: What are you three talking about?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, Familiar! These two were just taking some pics for me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grandma asked to see me in my signature racewear, so I thought I'd send her a few pictures! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Here, come take a look! Didn't they come out incredible?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She shows me her camera roll, where there are a ton of pictures of her in her signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Right?! They've captured my outfit right down to the texture of the material and the smallest decorations! They really caught my witchiness too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: They both have a great eye! It's like these pictures were taken with a time-stopping spell!

text_block_list.name: Vodka and Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe… It was nothing! ♪ Heh-heh… It was nothin'!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I know! Let's get some even better ones since we're already at it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: More magical and more sparkly! I want them as good as a movie poster!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah… So, um… What would that look like, I wonder…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Can amateurs even take those kinds of pictures? I mean, we only have our phone cameras.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What the heck?! I just got done saying how good you two are, and now you're saying you can't do it?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I just know you can take even better pictures than these! So hop to it! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right, already! Fine! If you're gonna be like that, then I'll try!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Good grief… Well, I am number one, so I'll just have to show you that I'm the number-one photographer too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yay! Now we're talking! So, what kind of picture should we take next?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar! Help me brainstorm! What's a good idea?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly put on the spot, I start to think… Maybe a change of location would help.
choice_data_list: How about an artistic shot somewhere desolate?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh! I know a good place! It's a little far, but follow me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: My dad took me here on his motorcycle the other day! What do you think? Isn't it cool?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's great! It's like a wasteland where the cool witches hang out!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, now that's a nice breeze! You look so cool with your racewear blowing in the wind! Quick, strike a pose!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah! Get one more to the side! Hurry! Before the wind stops!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: How about this angle? Okay, I'm taking it… Oh yes! You look very cool!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's great! You're getting it! Now get this pose next!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait, look at the reflector! The angle of light is totally wrong! Do it right!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Phew! Being a genius magical girl is great and all, but maybe I should call myself a lone-wolf genius witch instead.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Look at the time. That took forever.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But we got some awesome pics out of it! Hehehe. I think Grandma's gonna love them!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: In that case, I know a great spot. It's been super popular lately for Umastagram pictures.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: This place is fantastic! It's so witchy! You really know your stuff, Scarlet! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I thought you'd like it. Shall we order some of their best-looking desserts?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mm-mm-mmm! That smells so good…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's a great smile! Perfect time for a picture!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ouch! Geez, this is way too hot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, stop! Don't move! Just point your face this way!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You can still take pictures when I move, can't you? Actually, can't you even take moving pictures?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But more importantly… Your cake looks pretty yummy, Familiar! Can I have a bite?
choice_data_list: Sure, just stay still for a second!
Sure, just stay still for a second!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Look at the time. That took forever.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But we got some awesome pics out of it! Hehehe. I think Grandma's gonna love them!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All three of you did just as I expected. Not bad, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe! And as the ultimate compliment, I'll be sure to ask you all to help me again sometime. ♪ That's pretty special!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Phew! That was pretty rough.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's for sure. But… she looked so happy, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look at the sinking sun, thinking to myself that I know just how they feel.
